commits.content: @startuml TA_Recruitment_System_Analysis_Model ' ================= Global Style Settings ================= !theme plain skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0 skinparam linetype ortho skinparam nodesep 70 skinparam ranksep 90 skinparam roundcorner 12 skinparam shadowing true skinparam defaultFontName Arial ' ================= Color Palette & Stereotype Styles ================= ' Define custom colors for different EBC stereotypes skinparam class { ' Boundary Classes (Soft Pink/Peach) BackgroundColor<> #FFF0F5 BorderColor<> #DB7093 HeaderBackgroundColor<> #FFB6C1 ' Control Classes (Soft Blue) BackgroundColor<> #F0F8FF BorderColor<> #4682B4 HeaderBackgroundColor<> #B0C4DE ' Entity Classes (Soft Mint Green) BackgroundColor<> #F5FFFA BorderColor<> #2E8B57 HeaderBackgroundColor<> #A9DFBF ' General Arrow and Font Styles ArrowColor #555555 ArrowThickness 1.5 FontColor #333333 } skinparam package { BackgroundColor #FAFAFA BorderColor #CCCCCC FontColor #555555 FontSize 14 } ' ================= Legend ================= legend bottom System Architecture Color Legend (EBC Pattern) |= Color |= Stereotype |= Responsibility | | | <> | User Interfaces & External API Endpoints | | | <> | Business Logic, Orchestration & Processing | | | <> | Persistent Data Models & Core Information | endlegend ' ================= System Architecture ================= package "Boundary Layer (User Interfaces)" <> { class AuthUI <> { + displayLoginForm(): void + displayRegistrationForm(): void + showErrorMessage(msg: String): void } class TADashboardUI <> { + renderJobListings(jobs: List): void + displayApplicationHistory(apps: List): void + showProfileForm(profile: ApplicantProfile): void } class MODashboardUI <> { + displayJobCreationForm(): void + renderMyJobPostings(jobs: List): void + displayApplicantList(applicants: List): void + showRatingForm(app: Application): void } class AdminDashboardUI <> { + renderWorkloadMetrics(workloads: List): void + displayFairnessIndex(indexData: Float): void + showOverloadAlerts(alerts: List): void + displayAuditLogs(logs: List): void } } package "Control Layer (Business Logic)" <> { class AuthenticationController <> { + login(email: String, pass: String): User + registerTA(email: String, pass: String): TA + logout(user: User): void + verifySession(token: String): Boolean } class ProfileManager <> { + createProfile(ta: TA, data: ProfileData): ApplicantProfile + updateAvailability(ta: TA, slots: List): void + uploadCV(ta: TA, file: File): Boolean } class JobLifecycleController <> { + createDraftJob(mo: ModuleOrganiser, data: JobData): JobPosting + publishJob(jobID: String): void + closeJob(jobID: String): void + fetchOpenJobs(): List } class ApplicationController <> { + submitApplication(ta: TA, job: JobPosting): Application + withdrawApplication(appID: String): void + fetchHistoryByTA(ta: TA): List } class CandidateScreeningController <> { + updateApplicationStatus(appID: String, status: String): void + rateApplicant(appID: String, score: Float, feedback: String): void + bulkReject(appIDs: List): void + runAutomatedFiltering(jobID: String): List } class WorkloadAnalyzer <> { + calculateTotalHours(ta: TA, term: String): Integer + detectOverload(ta: TA): Boolean + generateFairnessIndex(term: String): Float + generateManagementReport(): Report } class AuditLogger <> { + logAction(user: User, action: String, details: String): void + retrieveLogs(dateRange: DateRange): List } } package "Entity Layer (Data Models)" <> { abstract class User <> { - userID: String - email: String - passwordHash: String - role: RoleEnum - isActive: Boolean + getUserDetails(): UserData } class TA <> { - studentID: String - department: String + getProfile(): ApplicantProfile } class ModuleOrganiser <> { - staffID: String - faculty: String } class Admin <> { - adminLevel: Integer } class ApplicantProfile <> { - profileID: String - fullName: String - skills: List - availableHours: Integer - cvDocumentURL: String + updateSkills(newSkills: List): void } class JobPosting <> { - jobID: String - title: String - description: String - requirements: String - deadline: Date - status: JobStatusEnum - requiredHours: Integer + updateStatus(newStatus: JobStatusEnum): void } class Application <> { - applicationID: String - submissionDate: Date - status: AppStatusEnum - moRating: Float - feedback: String + calculateMatchingScore(): Float } class WorkloadRecord <> { - recordID: String - term: String - allocatedHours: Integer - assignedModules: List - isOverloaded: Boolean + addHours(hours: Integer): void } class AuditLog <> { - logID: String - timestamp: DateTime - actionType: String - description: String } } ' ================= Relationships ================= ' Inheritance User <|-- TA User <|-- ModuleOrganiser User <|-- Admin ' Boundary to Control (User Actions) AuthUI ..> AuthenticationController : "delegates auth >" TADashboardUI ..> ProfileManager : "manages profile >" TADashboardUI ..> ApplicationController : "handles applies >" TADashboardUI ..> JobLifecycleController : "views jobs >" MODashboardUI ..> JobLifecycleController : "manages jobs >" MODashboardUI ..> CandidateScreeningController : "reviews >" AdminDashboardUI ..> WorkloadAnalyzer : "requests metrics >" AdminDashboardUI ..> AuditLogger : "views logs >" ' Control to Entity (Data Manipulation) AuthenticationController --> User : "authenticates >" ProfileManager --> TA : "updates >" ProfileManager --> ApplicantProfile : "modifies >" JobLifecycleController --> ModuleOrganiser : "validates >" JobLifecycleController --> JobPosting : "CRUD operations >" ApplicationController --> Application : "creates/updates >" ApplicationController --> TA : "links >" ApplicationController --> JobPosting : "links >" CandidateScreeningController --> Application : "evaluates >" WorkloadAnalyzer --> WorkloadRecord : "calculates >" WorkloadAnalyzer --> TA : "monitors >" AuditLogger --> AuditLog : "creates >" ' Entity to Entity (Data Relationships) TA "1" -- "1" ApplicantProfile : "owns >" ModuleOrganiser "1" -- "0..*" JobPosting : "creates >" JobPosting "1" -- "0..*" Application : "receives >" TA "1" -- "0..*" Application : "submits >" TA "1" -- "0..*" WorkloadRecord : "has >" @enduml
